title: 第11章 非人却像人的罪
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

可猴子怎么可能会修核电站呢？

不搞炸了就算好的了！

在绝望中，寓乐来到了大门他们的386号定居点。

这儿不大，有着符合废土居民身份的简陋和野蛮人外观的狂野。

如果是来旅游的话，寓乐可能会对这些新奇的建筑风格产生浓厚的兴趣。

但鉴于现在他是在生死线上挣扎求存。

他也就没有任何兴趣多看几眼了。

他只是麻木而平静的坐在车上。

看着大门他们兴高采烈的对着围拢来的同伴介绍自己。

“快来，快来，快把里面所有人都叫来，这是一位贵人，天大的贵人！”

“而且贵人还答应了帮我们修好神机，快，快跪下，快感谢贵人的恩德！”

起初，定居点里的男女老少，还对外表平平的寓乐没有任何反应。

他们只是奇怪的看着‘所获颇丰’的大门他们。

同时奇怪着为什么回来的人有点少。

可等到一说寓乐是贵人，这群三等人瞬间就是满心惶恐的跪了下去。

他们居然以打量的态度直视了一位贵族老爷！

这少说都得吃几条鞭子！

不过随后他们就听到大门说贵人答应帮他们修好神机，这一点又叫他们喜出望外。

纷纷在无言中激动了起来。

不过，依旧没有人敢抬头。

看着这样一群人，寓乐没有过多理会的心思。

他一直在想，自己如果修不好要怎么办。

他清楚这些人除了畏惧他的身份外，更多的就是有求于他。

一旦他们发现自己也修不好神机，还给不了其余好处的话。

寓乐很难想象会怎么样。

只能确定，这群人恐怕会比那些蛮子还可怕。

毕竟他们有自己的‘家’！

更遑论为了救自己，他们又死了那么多人...

叹了口气的寓乐，对着大门说道：

“不要弄这些有的没的，我不在乎，所以，机器在哪儿？”

走一步，看一步吧。

寓乐只能这么安慰着自己。

大门和其余人都有些惊奇寓乐居然将神机随意的称呼为机器。

那可是，那可是人类的遗产啊！

content_en:
Page (1/3)

But how could a monkey build a nuclear power plant?

It’ll be fine if it doesn’t explode!

In desperation, Yule came to the gate to their settlement No. 386.

It's not a big place, with a rough and barbarian appearance that fits the identity of the wasteland residents.

If you are traveling, you may have a strong interest in these novel architectural styles.

But now he is struggling to survive on the line of life and death.

He no longer had any interest in taking another look.

He just sat numbly and calmly in the car.

Looking at the gate, they happily introduced themselves to their companions who gathered around them.

"Come on, come on, call everyone inside, this is a noble man, a great noble man!"

"Furthermore, you have promised to help us repair the divine machine. Hurry, kneel down and thank you for your kindness!"

At first, the men, women, and children in the settlement had no reaction to the mediocre appearance of Yule.

They just looked at the door of "Getting a Lot" strangely.

At the same time, I was wondering why so few people came back.

But when it was said that Yule was a noble person, these third-class people immediately knelt down in fear.

They actually looked directly at an aristocratic gentleman with an appraising attitude!

It takes a lot of whipping to say the least!

But then they heard from the gate that the noble promised to help them repair the magic machine, which made them overjoyed.

They all became excited silently.

However, no one dared to look up.

Looking at such a group of people, Yule didn't pay much attention to them.

He kept thinking about what he would do if he couldn't fix it.

He knew that besides being afraid of his identity, these people wanted more from him.

Once they find out that they can't repair the magic machine and can't provide other benefits.

It’s hard to imagine what it would be like.

It can only be determined that this group of people is probably scarier than those barbarians.

After all, they have their own ‘home’!

Not to mention that so many people died in order to save themselves...

Yule sighed and said to the door:

"Don't do this. I don't care. So, where is the machine?"

Take a step, take a look.

Yu Le can only comfort himself in this way.

Damen and the others were a little surprised that Yule casually called the divine machine a machine.

That is, that is the heritage of mankind!
